note: Second shop of the B07 covered arcade (glass skylight, honey limestone pilasters, dark oak joinery, as on the exterior): the bookshop, with navy-blue bookshelves and a herringbone oak parquet. LANDMARK: the tall round tower bookcase with its brass spiral library ladder. The doorway on the far left shows the sage-green general store with its brass till (way back); the doorway on the far right shows the pale grey fashion boutique with its chandelier (next shop). Feminine nouns on the left, masculine on the right. Zooms: the round tower bookcase (z1) and the tall left-hand shelves (z2).
